title: Two Ways

serves.summary: The learner adds three piles two different ways, choosing which two go together first, and sees that the total stays the same, which shows the associative property of addition.

request.topic: Grouping three addends two different ways
request.objective: Add three numbers by putting two together first, then add them again with a different two first, and see that the total stays the same.

problems.ask: Way 1 starts with 2 and 3. Finish it, then add the three piles a different way.
problems.goal: (2+3)+4 and (3+4)+2 both finished with 9 in all.

problems.ask: Add these three numbers two different ways. Pick which two go together first each time.
problems.goal: Two different first pairs, each with its right first box and 8 in all.

problems.ask: Add these three numbers two different ways. Can one way make a ten first?
problems.goal: Two different first pairs (one is 6 and 4), each finished with 15 in all.

problems.ask: Finish Way 1. For Way 2, put 2 and 3 together, and say how many in all before you add.
problems.goal: Way 1 makes 9; Way 2 total typed as 9 before its first box, which is 5.
